scope: Proposition 4.4 of the manuscript “Random Walks on Critical FK–Ising Maps and Liouville Brownian Motion” (preprints/Random-Walks-on-Critical-FK-Ising-Maps-and-Liouville-Brownian-Motion-October-5-2026/fk-ising-walk-limit.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 17d701d41c4cfec4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On every fixed realization supplied by Proposition 2.3, and for every T > 0, (ξn t )0≤t≤T =⇒ (Bh t )0≤t≤T in D([0, T], S2 ) for the Skorokhod J1 topology associated with the round metric ρ. Every subsequential path limit is continuous.
